label: Market pull
definition: Named buyers with a present need and a willingness to pay
score_5_means: Several named buyers already buying the imported or incumbent equivalent

label: Vietnam advantage
definition: A Vietnam-specific edge in feedstock, industry, buyers or know-how over neighbours
score_1_means: Any neighbour does it as well or better

label: Technical readiness
definition: Proven at commercial scale somewhere, and skills available in Vietnam
score_5_means: Commercial elsewhere and skills present in Vietnam

label: Route to market
definition: A legal route to sell within 1 to 2 years under current Vietnamese rules
score_5_means: Ordinary food or listed feed rules apply

label: Capital efficiency
definition: Capital needed for a first commercial step, relative to what Vietnamese and regional capital can fund
score_1_means: Tens to hundreds of USD millions before revenue
score_5_means: First revenue for under a few USD millions or via tolling

label: Defensibility
definition: Ability to hold a position against imports and incumbents
score_5_means: Function, logistics or IP that imports cannot easily match

label: Public value
definition: Contribution to feed and food security, trade balance, jobs and national capability
score_5_means: Large contribution to protein security or national capability
